title: Staged traffic venting and staged backpressure gating for soft landing under regional saturation
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Customers experienced abrupt cross-region outages during a traffic spike on 2026-01-30 where the regional circuit breaker tripped immediately and caused a hard failover, which increased tail latency and triggered client retries. This PR introduces a staged traffic venting and backpressure-gating mechanism designed to produce a soft landing during regional saturation events: progressive queue venting, an adaptive async-deadline shedder, and a short-lived admission gate that throttles new requests while preserving in-flight work. The goal is to reduce SLO violations and smooth client-visible latency spikes without resorting to full region eviction or immediate model variant fallback.

What this changes (summary):
- Adds a staged TrafficVenter controller that tracks node-level token throughput and local SLO credit and emits three vent levels (observe -> throttle -> quarantine) rather than binary circuit open/closed.
- Implements an AsyncDeadlineShedder to gracefully cancel low-priority async jobs (background embed/metadata tasks) when node deadline windows exceed thresholds, preserving higher-priority generation requests.
- Introduces an AdmissionGating layer at the regional router that applies fast-path checks and backpressure signals to upstream LB to avoid head-of-line locking.
- Adds telemetry (per-tenant vent_level, shed_count, gated_inflight) and dashboards to the Console for rapid incident triage.
- Small API compatibility shim so Dedicated customers can toggle the gating policy via their tenant config.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc linked (Linear: ENG-4321)
- [x] Unit tests for TrafficVenter state transitions
- [x] Integration test with regional router simulator (adds simulated overload scenarios)
- [x] Console metric hooks and example dashboard panels
- [x] Feature flag gating and Dedicated tenant opt-out

Notes and operational guidance: See the internal playbook: https://linear.app/eng/issue/ENG-4321 and runbook entry SUP-1184 for how to toggle vent levels and revert the feature flag. For initial rollout we recommend Canary in us-west-2 with a 1% traffic ring and monitoring for the gated_inflight metric.

Compatibility and risk: Non-breaking for API callers. The admission gate is enabled behind a feature flag by default off for existing Dedicated customers; hosted tenants will be ramped progressively. There is a small risk of increased 429s during emergency throttle windows; mitigations include the penalize-decay policy and quota-aware admission.

Merge plan: squash-merge after required approvals and green CI. Post-merge: enable canary for 1% traffic and keep the old circuit logic available behind a legacy toggle for 48h rollback window.

review_comments: Liam Ortiz (review): Overall design looks good; please add a short timeout hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping between observe and throttle. Also can we limit per-tenant gating to avoid noisy neighbor issues?
Maya Chen (author): Added 250ms hysteresis window and tenant-weighted vent counters; pushed a follow-up commit to handle tenant affinity.

Priya Desai (review): Tests are thorough. One nit: prefer explicit error types on admission gate failure instead of generic 429 to aid client behavior. Would like a small comment describing expected client retry semantics.
Maya Chen (author): Switched to ErrAdmissionOverflow and updated docs with retry guidance (backoff-500ms, jitter).
Ethan Park (approval): Verified integration test results in sim cluster; metrics align with expectations. Approving.
release_notes: Staged traffic venting and backpressure gating: Adds progressive vent levels, async deadline shedding, and admission gating to improve SLO stability during regional overloads. Rollout behind feature flag; see ENG-4321 and SUP-1184 for operational guidance.
